reason: No pre-run Git commit of protocol; user requested no commits. Existing block01 is exploratory and already observed. Do not relabel it as preregistered.
order: ABBA; A=LoRA, B=LoRA-FA; fresh process per arm
schedule: block number outer loop; lengths 512,2048,4096 inner loop
primary_metric: median step seconds within each arm, excluding data fetch, evaluation and saving
secondary_metrics: held-out loss at window 512 and training length
quality_scope: Short training at equal input-token budget; optimizer steps differ across lengths. No convergence or multi-seed quality claim.
validity: All suspend, power and foreign_reads checks required. Empirical sdb resolver limited to tested E3 model and current boot/mount layout. Unknown or void stops series; preserve all records.
analysis: After five blocks per length, use pinned F1 repeats rule on arm median seconds: delta=0.1*mean(A); pooled within-arm sigma; N=max(2,ceil(7.85*(sigma/delta)^2)). Minimum five blocks. Review required additions, then recompute once after target N. No automatic top-up in this script.
prior_report_scope: Tiny LLaMA microbenchmark and analytic adapter activation ratio. Its 50% Adam state reduction applies to square projections, not full VRAM. Current Qwen targets have different shapes; measure actual bytes.
billing: Runner bounds jobs but does not stop or destroy rented instance. Twelve additional blocks only; no automatic replacement or further study.
